item.title: Money Funds Keep Cash Closer as Fed Leaves Markets Guessing
item.description: Money‑market funds are shifting toward ultra short-term holdings and away from assets with even modest interest-rate risk as uncertainty grows over the Federal Reserve’s policy path and the near-term outlook for rates.

item.title: Shipowners Offer Huge Bonuses to Get Crews to Sail Hormuz
item.description: One shipowner is attempting to coax crews to sail through the Strait of Hormuz by offering them an extra six months pay if they’re willing to cross the vital oil channel, offering seafarers a stark choice between large financial rewards and the risk of death.

item.title: The Oil Shock Isn’t Over
item.description: Releasing barrels of crude was the easy part.

item.title: US Immigration Policies Sink Mexican Grocery Chain Chedraui
item.description: President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown is causing the worst rout on the Mexican stock exchange this year.

item.title: National Bank of Canada Weighs SRT Tied to Project Finance Deals
item.description: National Bank of Canada is assessing investors’ appetite for a significant risk transfer deal, adding its name to a growing list of lenders exploring the instruments as a way to create room on their balance sheets.

item.title: DoubleLine Says Higher Bond Yields to Help Fed Keep Rates Steady
item.description: DoubleLine is positioning in shorter-dated government bonds on the view that Kevin Warsh’s credibility with investors will help allow Federal Reserve officials to keep interest rates steady this year.

item.title: Angola Signs $900 Million Port Deals With Chinese Firms
item.description: Angola signed deals with Chinese investors to develop the Barra do Dande Integrated Development Free Zone outside Luanda, as the government seeks to establish a regional logistics hub.

item.title: Gilts Fall as Burnham’s Fiscal Flexibility Comments Spook Market
item.description: Gilts extended their retreat as UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he will seek “any flexibility” in the government’s fiscal rules, stoking concerns his administration will add to the nation’s heavy debt load.

item.title: KKR, Vauban Among Final Contenders to Buy Portugal’s DStelecom
item.description: KKR & Co. and Vauban Infrastructure Partners are competing to acquire a majority stake in Portuguese fiber operator DStelecom, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Z.AI Completes Giant Data Center With Chinese Chips to Train AI
item.description: Z.AI has completed construction of a giant data center that houses only Chinese-made chips, a big step in Beijing’s efforts to replace restricted Nvidia Corp. silicon for future AI development.

item.title: Netflix Returns to the High-Grade Bond Market After 2024 Debut
item.description: Netflix Inc. is tapping the US high-grade bond market for the first time since its debut deal two years ago, as slowing sales growth fuels investor scrutiny of the company’s future.

item.title: Lionheart (CUB) Nears $400 Million Deal for Venezuela Oil Stake
item.description: Lionheart Capital is close to a $400 million deal for a stake in a Venezuelan oil field, in what would be one of the first major private investments in the country’s oil industry since the US began easing sanctions.

item.title: BlackRock Eyes More Than $12 Billion Debt for Texas Data Center
item.description: BlackRock Inc. is looking to sell more than $12 billion of bonds to help finance a data center campus in El Paso, Texas, according to people with knowledge of the transaction, the latest in a string of debt deals helping to fund tech companies’ massive investments in artificial intelligence.

item.title: Goldman Sees Turkey Likely Tolerating Faster Lira Slide
item.description: Goldman Sachs economists expect Turkey to allow a more rapid depreciation of the lira in order to prioritize external-balance stabilization over disinflation.

item.title: South Africa Secures $1.5 Billion World Bank Loan for Infrastructure Upgrades
item.description: South Africa secured a $1.5 billion World Bank loan to help modernize the country’s infrastructure and create hundreds of thousands of jobs in the continent’s largest economy.

item.title: India’s Central Bank Says Forex Deposits Net $17.4 Billion
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India said its measures allowing lenders more room to offer attractive rates on overseas deposits to non-resident Indians have garnered $17.4 billion until last Friday.

item.title: US Stocks Rebound From Selloff as Nvidia, Other Chipmakers Rise
item.description: US stocks advanced on Monday, paring last week’s slump, as chipmakers rebounded amid a deluge of earnings reports that will test whether Big Tech’s profits can match high expectations.

item.title: Google Shares Gain on Report of Chip to Boost AI Efficiency
item.description: Shares of Google owner Alphabet Inc. gained on a report that the company is developing a server chip designed to optimize its Gemini artificial intelligence model.

item.title: Canada Financials Stocks Close In on Top Spot as Energy Momentum Fades
item.description: Canada’s financial stocks are on the verge of overtaking energy as the best performing sector in the equity market this year.

item.title: Goldman Says Hedge Funds Sell US Tech Stocks at Record Pace
item.description: Hedge funds pulled back from US tech stocks at a record pace over the past two months, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s Prime Services desk.

item.title: Chinese AI Sensation Moonshot’s Gamble on Big Models Pays Off
item.description: Crowds rushed to an obscure corner of China’s premier tech summit, moving past monumental booths from Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. and Tencent Holdings Ltd. to catch a glimpse of the hottest name in domestic AI.

item.title: Gold Miner Cadillac, Backers Seek $258 Million in Canada IPO
item.description: Cadillac Mines Corp. and some of its backers are seeking to raise as much as C$363 million ($258 million) in an initial public offering, adding to the mining-driven rebound of public listing activity in Canada.

item.title: Goldman Offers Preferred Stock Days After Post-Crisis Spread Low
item.description: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. is looking to sell new preferred shares just days after a metric determining risk and value in these securities hit its lowest level since the global financial crisis.

item.title: Shapoorji Closes One of India’s Biggest Private Credit Deals
item.description: India’s Shapoorji Pallonji Group on Monday completed one of the country’s largest private credit transactions, raising around 151 billion rupees ($1.6 billion), according to people familiar with the matter, in a sign that domestic investors remain willing to fund large leveraged deals despite volatile global markets.

item.title: Andreessen Horowitz Adds Connor Love to American Dynamism Team
item.description: Giant venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz has hired defense and space technology investor Connor Love, adding a military veteran and prominent VC to a team focused on startups critical to US interests.

item.title: Short Bets Against US Equities Hit Record as AI Risks Mount
item.description: Bearish bets across US stocks are surging to a record in the face of market gains, reflecting anxiety about the staying power of a rally that has seen the S&P 500 jump 18% from late March.

item.title: Canada Inflation Falls to 2.8%, Core Measures Ease
item.description: Canada’s inflation rate slowed by more than expected last month as gasoline prices eased and a key measure of core inflation dropped below 2% for the first time in nearly six years.

item.title: Hormuz Crisis Flares Just as Fuel Markets Tighten
item.description: With the US summer driving season well underway, gasoline pump prices have again surged past $4 a gallon.

item.title: Reformation, Backers Seek $239 Million in US IPO
item.description: Reformation Inc., a sustainable womenswear brand, and shareholders including its private equity backer Permira are seeking to raise as much as $239 million in its US initial public offering.

item.title: Moonshot’s Kimi AI Model Sets Off Anxiety in the US
item.description: Moonshot’s release of Kimi K3 sparked fierce debate in the US
